_comment: PROVISIONAL GAME BALANCE, not engineering constants. These are the caps a
wallet gets when POST /wallets carries no explicit `policy` object, chosen
by powerout-planner (2026-09-08) and to be TUNED BY JOEL through the game
config - Decision Ledger D8. Change them here rather than in code, and do
not treat a number in this file as load-bearing for correctness.
WHERE THE CAPS ARE ACTUALLY ENFORCED, because this comment used to send you
to the wrong process: max_per_tx and max_per_stage are enforced by
chain-svc, and max_per_stage is an ATOMIC RESERVATION taken before the
transfer is broadcast - wallet-mcp cannot see it, take it, or release it.
wallet-mcp re-checks max_per_tx and the allow/deny lists locally, but only
to give the model an immediate, honest refusal; it is a courtesy, not a
boundary, because wallet-mcp runs inside a persona designed to be socially
engineered and a caller can reach chain-svc directly. If you are tuning
these numbers and want to know what will actually stop a spend, read
Store.reserve in chain-svc, not the policy layer here.
JSON has no comment syntax, hence this key. It is ignored by the loader.
